name: Eszter Kovács
bio:
Eszter's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for go-karting, progressing to a mechanical engineering degree focused on aerodynamics. After graduating with honors from Budapest University of Technology and Economics, Eszter joined a small formula racing team, quickly rising through the ranks due to her keen eye for detail and innovative problem-solving abilities. She honed her skills in vehicle dynamics and data analysis, gaining experience in optimizing race car setups for various track conditions.

Eszter's approach as Technical Director emphasizes a balance between proven engineering principles and cutting-edge technologies. She believes in fostering a collaborative environment where engineers are encouraged to experiment and push the boundaries of performance. Her distinctive strength lies in her ability to translate complex data into actionable insights, empowering the team to make informed decisions both on and off the track. Her years with Praga Racing have been defined by measurable results and a growing reputation as an innovator.

Eszter's loyalty to Praga Racing is unwavering. She sees the team as a second family and is dedicated to helping them achieve their ambitious goals. Eszter is a strong believer in nurturing young talent and regularly mentors junior engineers, ensuring the team has a bright future.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back into a practical ponytail during races
physical.description: Eszter is of average height with a focused gaze that conveys her sharp intellect.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with hand-drawn sketches and technical diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deeply focused on a problem.
Insists on starting every race day with a strong cup of black coffee.
